title: Operator Drift
style: deep dub-techno, 110 BPM, 336hz subharmonic, taut male spoken word, single ride bell, vinyl crackle, slow build, cinematic, no resolution
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Frequency open, nobody there
Static holds the shape of a prayer
Third shift, fourth wall, fifth drink down
The dispatcher talks to an empty town

[Verse 2]
Call it in, call it out
Signal lost, signal doubt
I was trained to stay on the line
Even when the line goes blind

[Chorus]
Operator drift — nobody's fault
Operator drift — the frequency halts
Somewhere a voice said copy that
I said copy that back
